tasks.title: Задача 1
tasks.statement:
Let pn (k) be the number of permutations of the set {1, . . . , n}, n ≥ 1, which
   have exactly k fixed points. Prove that

    (Remark: A permutation f of a set S is a one-to-one mapping of S onto itself.
    An element i in S is called a fixed point of the permutation f if f (i) = i.)

tasks.title: Задача 2
tasks.statement:
In an acute-angled triangle ABC the interior bisector of the angle A intersects
   BC at L and intersects the circumcircle of ABC again at N . From point L
   perpendiculars are drawn to AB and AC, the feet of these perpendiculars being
   K and M respectively. Prove that the quadrilateral AKN M and the triangle
   ABC have equal areas.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).
